guidance.heading: Guidance for 2026
section: Based on the Company’s year-to-date results, its view on current market conditions, and its outlook for the remainder of 2026, management currently believes the Company’s full-year 2026 net income and FFO per share will be as follows:

For the year ending December 31, 2026: | Current | Previous
Low Range | High Range | Low Range | High Range
Estimated diluted net income per share | $1.08 | $1.12 | $1.06 | $1.13
Depreciation and amortization of real estate assets - consolidated and the Company’s share of unconsolidated joint ventures | 1.41 | 1.41 | 1.39 | 1.39
Estimated diluted FFO per share | $2.49 | $2.53 | $2.45 | $2.52
The above estimates reflect the following key assumptions (dollars in millions):

For the year ending December 31, 2026: | Current | Previous
Low Range | High Range | Low Range | High Range
Same Center NOI growth - total portfolio at pro rata share | 3.50 | 4.25 | 2.75 | 4.25
General and administrative expense | $80.5 | $83.5 | $80.5 | $83.5
Interest expense, net of interest income - consolidated | $70.5 | $71.7 | $71.0 | $73.0
Annual recurring capital expenditures, renovations, and second generation tenant allowances and other leasing costs | $70.0 | $75.0 | $65.0 | $75.0

Weighted average diluted common shares are expected to range from approximately 115.5 million to 116.5 million for earnings per share and 120.0 million to 121.0 million for FFO and Core FFO per share. The current guidance does not include the impact of any future acquisition or sale of any properties, outparcels, or joint venture interests, or any additional financing activity.
